Subject: Kickoff next Tuesday

Hi Doyun,
Looking forward to the kickoff on Tuesday. We want to refresh the onboarding flow in the mobile app and cut drop-off on the sign-up screen.
Please come with any questions you have about scope and timeline.

Alex
